column1: # Tinh Tú phonetic overrides for vi-VN system TTS.
# Lines beginning with # are ignored. Empty lines skipped.
# ORDER MATTERS: list the domain form (vnexpress.net) BEFORE the bare brand
# (VnExpress). Rules apply top-to-bottom; if the bare brand ran first it would
# consume "vnexpress" inside "vnexpress.net" and leave the orphan ".net"
# the TTS then reads as "chấm net". Domain-first keeps the suffix from leaking.
# ─── English abbreviations heard as Vietnamese letters ─────────────────
# Sep 26 2026: honorific titles read before artists' names; spelled out letter by letter
# they are not how Vietnamese press reads them (11 + 7 hits in 140 live items).
# ─── K-pop names commonly mentioned in Vietnamese press ─────────────────
# ─── V-pop & Vietnamese stars that benefit from a written-out pronunciation
# Sep 26 2026: the stage name is the Vietnamese "Hiếu thứ hai"; the old row read "hi yu".
